title: Cross-Lingual Gaps in Visual STEM Reasoning: Auditing VLMs Across Six Indian Languages
abstract: arXiv:2603.26742v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are benchmarked on diagram-grounded science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) reasoning mostly in English, so it is unclear how much their accuracy changes when the same problem is posed in another language. We audit this for six Indian languages: 980 questions from MathVista, ScienceQA, and MMMU are machine-translated into Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, and Kannada with IndicTrans2 while the images stay unchanged. We evaluate seven open-weight VLMs (Qwen2.5-VL-7B/32B, Qwen3-VL-30B, InternVL2.5-8B, Aya-Vision-8B, Gemma 3-27B, Llama-4-Maverick) and GPT-4o, plus no-image and chain-of-thought (CoT) ablations on Qwen2.5-VL-7B (68,600 inference records). Accuracy falls 9.8-24.9 percentage points (pp) from English to the Indian-language mean, and every model loses more on the Dravidian than on the Indo-Aryan languages (by 0.1-13.2 pp). translated_title: 视觉STEM推理中的跨语言差距：跨越六种印度语言审计视觉语言模型
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在基于图表的科学技术工程数学（STEM）推理方面的基准测试大多以英语进行，因此当同一问题以另一种语言提出时，其准确率会如何变化尚不清楚。我们对六种印度语言进行了审计：将来自MathVista、ScienceQA和MMMU的980道题目通过IndicTrans2机器翻译成印地语、孟加拉语、马拉地语、泰米尔语、泰卢固语和卡纳达语，同时保持图像不变。我们评估了七个开源权重的VLM（Qwen2.5-VL-7B/32B、Qwen3-VL-30B、InternVL2.5-8B、Aya-Vision-8B、Gemma 3-27B、Llama-4-Maverick）以及GPT-4o，并在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上进行了无图像和思维链（CoT）消融实验（共计68,600条推理记录）。结果显示，从英语到印度语的平均准确率下降了9.8至24.9个百分点，且每个模型在达罗毗荼语系语言上的损失都比印度-雅利安语系语言更大（差距为0.1至13.2个百分点）。对于使用本文提示词的Qwen2.5-VL-7B，思维链降低了孟加拉语……
tldr: 该论文构建了六种印度语言的视觉STEM推理审计基准，发现视觉语言模型从英语切换到印度语言时准确率下降9.8至24.9个百分点，且达罗毗荼语系语言的性能下降比印度-雅利安语系更严重。
en_tdlr: This paper audits visual STEM reasoning across six Indian languages and finds that VLMs lose 9.8-24.9 percentage points of accuracy when moving from English to Indian languages, with Dravidian languages suffering larger drops than Indo-Aryan ones.
